source.basis: Rounded national-average retail prices recalled from well-known public sources (BLS CPI average prices, USDA, EIA, AAA, STR, DOT, FDA/KFF) and published list prices; not queried live. Apply regions.cost_of_living_multiplier to scale for local conditions (it moves most goods less than rent). Sales tax is not included.

basis.doc: Where the category's figures come from.

price_unit_note.doc: Fuel category only: which items price per gallon and which per kWh.

price_cents.doc: Min of the items' mins, median of their typicals (even counts: the mean of the middle two, rounded up), max of their maxes.

groceries_staples.name: Groceries: per-item staples
groceries_staples.basis: BLS CPI average prices (2025) and USDA retail scans, rounded; min = store brand or sale, max = organic or premium.

groceries_baskets.name: Groceries: weekly baskets
groceries_baskets.basis: USDA Food Plans, cost of food at home (2025 monthly reports), converted to weekly. Individual figures are for an adult 19-50; family is two adults and two children.
groceries_baskets.notes: Use per-item staples for single purchases and baskets for the abstract weekly grocery spend.

meals_out.name: Fast food and sit-down meals
meals_out.basis: National chain menu prices and BLS CPI food-away-from-home trends (2025), rounded. Prices exclude tax and tip.
meals_out.notes: Typical tip guidance: 15-20% for table service, none or optional at counters.

alcohol.name: Alcohol
alcohol.basis: Retail shelf prices and bar menu prices (2025), rounded.
alcohol.notes: Legal drinking age 21 in all states.

clothing.name: Clothing, basics through outerwear
clothing.basis: Big-box and mall retail prices (2025), rounded; min = discount or sale, max = premium mainstream (not designer).

electronics.name: Electronics
electronics.basis: Retail list and street prices (2025), rounded; min = budget or older generation, max = high-end consumer.

tools_hardware.name: Tools and hardware
tools_hardware.basis: Home-improvement retail prices (2025), rounded; min = house brand, max = prosumer.

medical.name: Medical
medical.basis: KFF, Healthcare Bluebook / FAIR Health typical charges and common plan copays (2025), rounded; "uninsured" rows are cash or billed amounts, insured patients pay copays, deductibles and coinsurance instead.
medical.notes: Monthly premiums and deductibles are in finance.json.

entertainment.name: Entertainment
entertainment.basis: Box-office, venue and retailer prices (2025), rounded.

transport.name: Transport (public and for-hire)
transport.basis: Transit agencies, TNC and taxi rate cards, DOT Air Travel Consumer Report and Amtrak fares (2025), rounded; rideshare rates vary widely by metro and surge.

fuel.name: Fuel and charging
fuel.basis: AAA / EIA 2025 national average pump prices with state ranges, EV charging from network rate cards and EIA, marina fuel-dock quotes, rounded. Fuel prices are in cents per gallon (or per kWh for charging), so 315 means $3.15.
fuel.price_unit_note: All prices are integer cents. Per-kWh rows are in cents per kWh.

vehicle_services.name: Vehicle services
vehicle_services.basis: AAA, Consumer Reports, RepairPal and shop price sheets (2025), rounded; shop labor rates run $110-$200 per hour.

lodging.name: Lodging
lodging.basis: STR / CoStar average daily rates by segment, KOA and recreation.gov camping fees (2025), rounded; before taxes and resort fees.

utilities.name: Utilities and services (monthly)
utilities.basis: EIA, FCC/Ookla, BLS CPI and major-carrier price lists (2025), rounded. Household electricity use is about 860 kWh per month nationally (EIA), so a typical bill is roughly kWh x state rate in regions.json.

subscriptions.name: Subscriptions
subscriptions.basis: Published US list prices (late 2025), rounded; "per year" rows are annual fees.

gifts.name: Gifts and occasions
gifts.basis: Typical consumer spending from retailer and NRF survey patterns (2025), rounded.
